heading: Raj Thackeray reel row: Pune influencer Mahesh Mote allegedly made to prostrate, do sit-ups and record apology
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Social media influencer Mahesh Mote was allegedly humilated by MNS workers in Pune over a reel involving Raj Thackeray. Videos show him with black ink on his face, doing sit-ups and apologising before a photograph of the MNS chief.
